newsitem.title: USA: Adtran says gets US West contract.
newsitem.headline: Adtran says gets US West contract.

text.p: Adtran Inc said Monday it received "substantial channel unit business' from the U S West Communications Group
Spokesmen were not immediately available to comment on the size and value of the order.
U S West will buy Adtran's digital channel units to service customers needing high-speed connectivity for networking, office data transfer and Internet access, a company statement said.

Adtran posted earnings of $0.24 per share in the first quarter, compared with $0.22 the year before. Brokerage house Dain Bosworth cut Adtran to a hold from a buy June 11. Its stock traded at 25 around noon on Monday, down 1/4.
